## [5] Docker Compose Installation
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/installation/docker-compose
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Docker Compose deploys Kestra with PostgreSQL. Image:
  kestra/kestra:latest. Command: server standalone --worker-thread=128.
  Volumes: /app/storage, /var/run/docker.sock, /tmp/kestra-wd. Default
  credentials: admin@kestra.io:kestra. Enterprise image at
  registry.kestra.io/docker/kestra-ee:latest.

## [7] Standalone Server Installation
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/installation/standalone-server
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Standalone JAR requires Java 21+. Local mode uses embedded H2.
  Standalone mode requires external database. Default config search:
  ${HOME}/.kestra/config.yaml. Ships without plugins. Systemd unit template
  with Type=simple and KillMode=mixed.

## [8] Hardware and Software Requirements
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/administrator-guide/requirements
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Minimum 4 GiB RAM, 2 vCPUs. Runtime JDK 25; source/target 21.
  PostgreSQL 14+, MySQL 8+. Enterprise: Kafka 3+, Elasticsearch 7+. Storage:
  MinIO 8+, S3, GCS, Azure Blob. Docker-in-Docker required for script tasks.
  Standalone server: 10 DB connections. Component-separated: 40 connections.

## [9] Deployment Architecture
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/architecture/deployment-architecture
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Three deployment patterns: Standalone (single process, DB only),
  JDBC-Based (DB as communication backbone, PostgreSQL/MySQL, no HA), Kafka-Based
  (Enterprise only, HA, horizontal scaling). Kafka Executor as Kafka Streams app.
  Elasticsearch as webserver database.

## [14] Task Retries Configuration
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/workflow-components/retries
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Three strategies: Constant, Exponential (delayFactor default 2),
  Random (minInterval/maxInterval). Properties: maxAttempts, maxDuration,
  warningOnRetry, interval. Flow-level: CREATE_NEW_EXECUTION or
  RETRY_FAILED_TASK. ISO 8601 durations. Global defaults via plugin config.

- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)

## [16] Schedule Trigger
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/workflow-components/triggers/schedule-trigger
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Cron expressions plus @yearly, @monthly, @weekly, @daily, @hourly.
  L for last day of month. Timezone property (e.g., America/New_York). UTC
  default. Backfill: recoverMissedSchedules (ALL/LAST/NONE). Multiple schedules
  per flow. Conditional scheduling (DayWeekInMonth, Weekend, PublicHoliday).
  stopAfter for auto-disable. ScheduleMonitor for stuck triggers.

## [17] REST API Guide
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/how-to-guides/api
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Basic Auth (admin@kestra.io:kestra default). Enterprise: Bearer
  tokens. Create flow: POST /api/v1/main/flows (YAML). Execute: POST
  /api/v1/main/executions/{namespace}/{id}. Retrieve: GET
  /api/v1/main/executions/{executionId}. KV Store CRUD. Namespace files CRUD.

## [18] Webhook Trigger
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/workflow-components/triggers/webhook-trigger
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** URL: /api/v1/main/executions/webhook/{namespace}/{flowId}/{key}.
  Basic Auth required since Kestra 0.24. Methods: GET, POST, PUT. Access:
  {{ trigger.body }}, {{ trigger.headers }}, {{ trigger.parameters }}. wait:true
  for synchronous. returnOutputs:true for response body. responseContentType
  configurable.

## [19] Secrets Concept
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/concepts/secret
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Enterprise: UI-managed secrets with descriptions and tags. OSS:
  base64-encoded env vars with SECRET_ prefix. secret() function (no prefix
  in call). Automatic base64 decoding at runtime. Built-in log protection.
  Credentials feature for managed token refresh.

## [20] Secrets How-To Guide
- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/how-to-guides/secrets
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
- **Tier:** 2 (Official documentation)
- **Data:** Create .env file, encode with SECRET_ prefix + base64, reference
  .env_encoded in docker-compose.yaml env_file. Usage: {{ secret('KEY_NAME') }}.
  Batch encoding via bash script. OSS secrets are base64-encoded (not
  encrypted). Built-in log protection prevents secrets from appearing in logs
  or flow definitions.

- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07

  Auto-purge expired KV pairs via global config.

- **URL:** https://kestra.io/docs/releases
- **Accessed:** 2026-04-07
